add-text-box-field-to-pdf-acroform.title: Create PDF with AcroForm Text Field
add-text-box-field-to-pdf-acroform.description: Shows how to generate a new PDF, add an AcroForm, and place a text box field on the first page using Aspose.Pdf for C#.

create-pdf-with-top-checkbox.title: Create PDF with AcroForm and Top‑Positioned Checkbox
create-pdf-with-top-checkbox.description: Shows how to generate a new PDF, add an AcroForm, and place a checkbox field near the top of the page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-gender-radio-button-group-to-pdf.title: Create PDF with Gender Radio Button AcroForm
add-gender-radio-button-group-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF, add a text label, and insert a radio button group for gender selection using Aspose.Pdf AcroForm features.

add-listbox-to-pdf-form.title: Create PDF with List Box AcroForm
add-listbox-to-pdf-form.description: Shows how to create a new PDF, add an AcroForm list box field, populate it with country options, and save the document.

create-acroform-textbox-appearance.title: Create AcroForm TextBox with Font and Color Appearance
create-acroform-textbox-appearance.description: Creates a new PDF, adds a TextBox AcroForm field, and customizes its appearance by setting font, size, text color, border, and optional background color.

fill-pdf-text-field.title: Fill Text Field in PDF Form
fill-pdf-text-field.description: Loads an existing PDF, locates a text box form field by its name, assigns a provided string value, and saves the modified document.

set-checkbox-field-in-pdf.title: Set Checkbox Field in PDF Form
set-checkbox-field-in-pdf.description: Loads an existing PDF, locates a checkbox form field, sets its checked state based on input data, and saves the modified document.

select-radio-button-option-in-pdf-form.title: Set Radio Button Value in PDF Form
select-radio-button-option-in-pdf-form.description: Loads an existing PDF, locates a radio button form field by name, sets its selected option, and saves the updated document.

select-listbox-option-in-pdf-form.title: Select ListBox Entry in PDF by Index
select-listbox-option-in-pdf-form.description: Loads an existing PDF, locates a ListBox form field, selects an option using its zero‑based index, and saves the modified document.

populate-pdf-form-fields-from-dictionary.title: Populate PDF Form Fields from Dictionary
populate-pdf-form-fields-from-dictionary.description: Shows how to load a PDF, iterate over its form fields, assign values from a case‑insensitive dictionary, and save the updated document.

read-pdf-form-field-value.title: Extract PDF Form Field Value and Print to Console
read-pdf-form-field-value.description: Shows how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locate a form field by its name, retrieve the field's value, and output it to the console.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-json.title: Extract PDF Form Fields to JSON
export-pdf-form-fields-to-json.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through its form fields, retrieves each field's value in a version‑tolerant way, and serializes the collected values into a formatted JSON string.

import-xfdf-form-data-into-pdf.title: Import XML Form Data into PDF
import-xfdf-form-data-into-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, parse an XML file, match XML elements to PDF form fields by name, set the field values, and save the updated document.

import-json-form-data-into-pdf.title: Import JSON Data into PDF Form Fields
import-json-form-data-into-pdf.description: Shows how to read a JSON file, map its key/value pairs to form field names, and populate various Aspose.Pdf form field types in a PDF document.

add-blank-page-to-pdf-form.title: Add Blank Page to PDF Form
add-blank-page-to-pdf-form.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF form, insert a new blank page while keeping existing fields intact, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-new-page-with-acroform-fields.title: Add a New Page with AcroForm Fields to a PDF
add-new-page-with-acroform-fields.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF, append a blank page, and place new AcroForm text box and checkbox fields on that page using Aspose.Pdf.

delete-form-field-from-pdf.title: Delete a Form Field from a PDF
delete-form-field-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, verify the existence of a specific form field by name, delete that field, and save the modified document using Aspose.Pdf.

flatten-pdf-remove-form-fields.title: Remove All Form Fields from PDF
flatten-pdf-remove-form-fields.description: Shows how to delete every form field in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, resulting in a plain, non‑interactive document.

set-form-field-border-color-width.title: Set Form Field Border Color and Width
set-form-field-border-color-width.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate a specific form field, and apply corporate styling by setting its border width and color using Aspose.Pdf.

highlight-required-form-fields.title: Highlight Required Form Fields in a PDF
highlight-required-form-fields.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locate specific form fields, change their color to highlight required input areas, and save the modified document.

set-font-size-style-pdf-textbox-field.title: Set Font Size and Style for PDF Form Text Field
set-font-size-style-pdf-textbox-field.description: Opens a PDF, finds a text box form field, updates its default appearance with a larger bold Arial font and black color, and saves the modified document.

set-pdf-form-field-read-only.title: Mark PDF Form Field as Read‑Only
set-pdf-form-field-read-only.description: Shows how to load a PDF, populate a text box form field, set it to read‑only, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

mark-pdf-form-field-as-required.title: Mark PDF Form Field as Required
mark-pdf-form-field-as-required.description: Shows how to open a PDF, locate a text box form field, set its Required property to true, and save the updated document.

add-tooltip-to-pdf-form-textbox.title: Add Tooltip to PDF Form Field
add-tooltip-to-pdf-form-textbox.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, locate a TextBox form field, set a tooltip (via the Contents property), and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

set-default-value-for-pdf-form-textbox.title: Set Default Value for PDF Form Field
set-default-value-for-pdf-form-textbox.description: Shows how to open a PDF, locate a text box form field by name, assign a default value that appears when the document is opened, and save the updated file.

add-blank-page-save-as-new-pdf.title: Add Text Annotation and Save Modified PDF
add-blank-page-save-as-new-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, adding a text annotation to the first page, and saving the modified document to a new file to preserve the original.

save-pdf-incremental-updates.title: Save PDF with Incremental Updates to Preserve Form Data
save-pdf-incremental-updates.description: Demonstrates opening a PDF with a read/write stream, updating a form field, and performing an incremental save so previous revisions of the form remain intact.

batch-fill-pdf-form-fields.title: Batch Fill PDF Form Fields with Identical Values
batch-fill-pdf-form-fields.description: Shows how to iterate through a folder of PDF documents and populate predefined form fields with the same values using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-fill-pdf-forms-from-xml.title: Batch Import XML Form Data into Multiple PDFs
batch-fill-pdf-forms-from-xml.description: Demonstrates iterating over PDF files, locating matching XML files, importing XML field values into PDF form fields, and saving the filled PDFs using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-export-pdf-form-data-to-xml.title: Batch Export PDF Form Data to XML
batch-export-pdf-form-data-to-xml.description: Iterates through PDF files in a folder, extracts AcroForm fields with Aspose.Pdf, and writes each document's form data to a separate XML file.

convert-pdf-form-json-to-csv.title: Convert Form Data JSON to CSV
convert-pdf-form-json-to-csv.description: Reads a JSON file containing form data records, deserializes it into dictionaries, and writes the data to a CSV file with proper header generation and value escaping.

validate-required-pdf-form-fields.title: Validate Required PDF Form Fields Before Saving
validate-required-pdf-form-fields.description: The example loads a PDF, checks that all AcroForm fields marked as required contain a non‑empty value, and saves the document only when validation passes.

acroform-with-margins.title: Create PDF with AcroForm Fields Using Relative Positioning
acroform-with-margins.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF with AcroForm text boxes and a checkbox, positioning the fields relative to page margins using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-with-xfa-form.title: Create and Populate an XFA Form in a PDF
create-pdf-with-xfa-form.description: Shows how to generate a PDF containing an XFA form, build its minimal XML dataset, and set field values using Aspose.Pdf when the XFA feature is enabled.

extract-xfa-form-data-to-xml.title: Extract XFA Form Data from PDF to XML
extract-xfa-form-data-to-xml.description: Demonstrates how to read the XFA packet from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, retrieve the datasets XML node, and save it as an external XML file.

import-xfa-data-from-xml.title: Import XFA Form Data from XML into PDF
import-xfa-data-from-xml.description: Shows how to load a PDF containing an XFA form, import XML data into the XFA datasets node, and save the populated PDF.

merge-pdfs-unique-acroform-field-names.title: Merge PDFs with AcroForm Fields and Preserve Unique Names
merge-pdfs-unique-acroform-field-names.description: Loads two PDF files, prefixes the AcroForm field names in the second document to avoid name clashes, appends its pages to the first PDF, and copies the renamed fields into the merged document.

fill-and-flatten-pdf-form-fields.title: Fill and Flatten PDF Form Fields
fill-and-flatten-pdf-form-fields.description: The example opens a PDF, fills a text box and a checkbox field, flattens the form so the fields become static content, and saves the resulting PDF.

restore-editability-of-flattened-pdf-for.title: Unflatten PDF Form Fields
restore-editability-of-flattened-pdf-for.description: Loads a previously flattened PDF, clears the ReadOnly flag on each form field to restore editability, and saves the resulting unflattened document.

set-form-field-appearance-custom-font.title: Set Custom Font for PDF Form Field
set-form-field-appearance-custom-font.description: Shows how to load an external TrueType/OpenType font and apply it to a textbox form field's default appearance in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

rotate-form-field-label.title: Add a 45° Rotated Label to a PDF Form Field
rotate-form-field-label.description: Demonstrates how to create a TextStamp, set its RotateAngle to 45 degrees, position it relative to a form field, and add it to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

hide-pdf-form-field.title: Hide PDF Form Field
hide-pdf-form-field.description: Shows how to hide a specific form field in a PDF by setting the Hidden annotation flag using Aspose.Pdf.

set-form-field-visible-non-printable.title: Set Form Field Visible but Not Printable
set-form-field-visible-non-printable.description: Demonstrates how to make a PDF form field visible on screen while preventing it from being printed by clearing the Hidden, Invisible, and Print annotation flags using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-form-data-to-pretty-json.title: Export PDF Form Data to Pretty‑Printed JSON
export-pdf-form-data-to-pretty-json.description: Demonstrates how to extract form field values from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, export them to a JSON file, and re‑serialize the JSON with indentation for human‑readable output.

import-form-data-from-compressed-json.title: Import Form Data from GZip‑Compressed JSON into PDF
import-form-data-from-compressed-json.description: Demonstrates how to decompress a GZip‑compressed JSON payload, parse it, and populate matching AcroForm fields in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

create-multi-page-pdf-with-acroform-fiel.title: Create Multi‑Page PDF with Distinct AcroForm Fields
create-multi-page-pdf-with-acroform-fiel.description: Demonstrates generating a PDF with several pages and adding a unique TextBoxField and CheckboxField to each page using Aspose.Pdf's AcroForm capabilities.

copy-form-field-to-another-page.title: Copy Form Field to Another Page in PDF
copy-form-field-to-another-page.description: Shows how to duplicate a form field, assign a new name, and place the copy on a different page within the same PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

rename-pdf-form-field.title: Rename PDF Form Field Programmatically
rename-pdf-form-field.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate a form field by its existing name, change its PartialName to a new name, and save the updated document.

clone-pdf-form-field-to-another-page.title: Clone PDF Form Field and Place on Another Page
clone-pdf-form-field-to-another-page.description: Demonstrates how to clone an existing form field, change its properties, and add the cloned field to a different page in a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

assign-javascript-onlostfocus-to-pdf-for.title: Assign JavaScript Action to PDF Form Field on Blur
assign-javascript-onlostfocus-to-pdf-for.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate a TextBox form field, and attach a JavaScript action that runs on the field's OnLostFocus (blur) event to calculate and set a value.

add-submit-button-to-pdf-form.title: Add Submit Button to PDF Form
add-submit-button-to-pdf-form.description: Shows how to create a button field on a PDF page, attach a SubmitFormAction that posts the form data to a specified URL, and save the modified document.

add-reset-button-to-pdf-form.title: Add Reset Button to PDF Form
add-reset-button-to-pdf-form.description: Shows how to insert a reset button into an existing PDF form using Aspose.Pdf, which clears all user‑entered data via a JavaScript action.

define-calculation-order-for-pdf-form-fi.title: Configure Auto-Recalculate for PDF Form Fields
define-calculation-order-for-pdf-form-fi.description: Demonstrates how to add or retrieve text box fields in a PDF, assign a JavaScript calculation action, and enable automatic recalculation so totals update when inputs change.

add-numeric-field-with-validation.title: Numeric Range Validation Utility
add-numeric-field-with-validation.description: Shows how to implement a simple validator that checks if a numeric value lies within an inclusive range and demonstrates its use in a console application.

list-pdf-form-field-names.title: List PDF Form Field Names
list-pdf-form-field-names.description: Shows how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, verify that form fields exist, and enumerate each field's name.

extract-text-box-form-fields.title: Filter PDF Form TextBox Fields Using LINQ
extract-text-box-form-fields.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, using LINQ to retrieve only TextBoxField form fields, setting a default value for each, and saving the modified document.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v2.title: Extract PDF Form Fields to JSON Schema
export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v2.description: Loads a PDF, enumerates its form fields, captures type, required flag, default values and constraints, and writes a JSON file that describes the form schema.

import-acroform-fields-from-json.title: Generate PDF with AcroForm Fields from JSON
import-acroform-fields-from-json.description: Creates a new PDF document and adds AcroForm fields (text boxes, check boxes, radio buttons) based on a JSON schema, demonstrating dynamic form generation with Aspose.Pdf.

fill-pdf-form-and-encrypt.title: Fill PDF Form Fields and Encrypt the Document
fill-pdf-form-and-encrypt.description: The example loads a PDF template, fills a text box, checkbox, and combo box form fields, then encrypts the PDF with user and owner passwords using AES‑256 before saving it.

apply-digital-signature-to-pdf.title: Apply Digital Signature to PDF Form
apply-digital-signature-to-pdf.description: Loads an existing PDF with filled form fields, creates a signature field, signs it with a PKCS#7 certificate (.pfx), and saves the signed document.

set-pdf-metadata-after-form-processing.title: Set PDF Metadata After Form Filling
set-pdf-metadata-after-form-processing.description: Loads a PDF form, fills a text box field, sets document metadata such as author and title, and saves the updated PDF.

fill-pdf-form-fields-from-stream.title: Fill PDF Form Fields from Byte Array
fill-pdf-form-fields-from-stream.description: Loads a PDF from a byte array, sets values for text boxes, check boxes, and radio buttons, and returns the modified PDF as a byte array.

async-import-xml-form-data-into-pdf.title: Asynchronously Import XML Form Data into a PDF
async-import-xml-form-data-into-pdf.description: Shows how to load XML data asynchronously, map each element to a matching PDF form field, and save the filled PDF without blocking the main thread.

parallel-fill-pdf-form-fields.title: Parallel Batch Fill PDF Form Fields
parallel-fill-pdf-form-fields.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf to fill the same set of form fields across many PDF files concurrently, improving batch processing performance with parallel execution.

log-form-field-modifications.title: Log PDF Form Field Modifications to a File
log-form-field-modifications.description: The example opens a PDF, iterates through its form fields, applies sample updates, logs any value changes to a text file, and saves the modified document.

generate-csv-summary-of-pdf-form-fields.title: Generate PDF Form Field Summary Report
generate-csv-summary-of-pdf-form-fields.description: The example scans a folder of PDF files, extracts all form field names and values using Aspose.Pdf, and writes a CSV summary report listing each file, field, and its value.

compare-pdf-form-data-diff-report.title: Compare PDF Form Fields and Generate Diff Report
compare-pdf-form-data-diff-report.description: Loads two PDF documents, iterates through their form fields, compares values, and writes a text report highlighting mismatches and fields that exist only in one of the PDFs.

create-pdf-template-with-form-fields.title: Create PDF Template with Placeholder Form Fields
create-pdf-template-with-form-fields.description: Shows how to generate a PDF template that contains text box form fields with placeholder values and corresponding labels using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-placeholder-with-current-date.title: Replace PDF Form Placeholder with Current Date
replace-placeholder-with-current-date.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate a TextBox form field, set its value to the current system date formatted as "MMMM dd, yyyy", and save the updated document.

create-multi-select-listbox.title: Populate Multi-Select List Box in PDF Form
create-multi-select-listbox.description: Shows how to enable multiple selection on a list box field, clear existing selections, and programmatically select specific options in a PDF form using Aspose.Pdf.

populate-combobox-from-datatable.title: Set Combo Box Options from Database in PDF Form
populate-combobox-from-datatable.description: Demonstrates how to retrieve values from a data source and programmatically populate a combo box field in an AcroForm PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-signature-field-to-pdf-form.title: Add Handwritten Signature Field to PDF
add-signature-field-to-pdf-form.description: Demonstrates how to insert a signature field into an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf, enabling users to apply handwritten digital signatures.

extract-signature-field-image.title: Extract Signature Field Appearance as Image
extract-signature-field-image.description: Loads a PDF, locates a signature field, crops the page to the field's rectangle, and renders that area to a PNG image for audit‑log purposes.

set-max-length-pdf-textbox-field.title: Set Maximum Length for PDF Form Text Field
set-max-length-pdf-textbox-field.description: Demonstrates how to restrict a PDF form text box to a specific maximum number of characters using Aspose.Pdf, with a reflection fallback to JavaScript validation when the property is unavailable.

enable-spell-checking-textbox-field.title: Create Text Box Form Field (Spell Check Not Supported)
enable-spell-checking-textbox-field.description: Demonstrates how to add a text box form field to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and notes that spell‑checking is not available in the library.

export-pdf-form-data-to-xml__v2.title: Export PDF Form Data to XML
export-pdf-form-data-to-xml__v2.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate over its form fields, and write each field's name and value to an XML file.

validate-xml-xsd-fill-xfa-pdf.title: Validate XML Against XSD and Fill PDF Form
validate-xml-xsd-fill-xfa-pdf.description: Shows how to validate an XML file using an XSD schema and then map the XML elements to matching fields in an Aspose.Pdf form, saving the populated PDF.

populate-pdf-form-fields-using-xslt.title: Populate PDF Form Fields from Transformed XML using XSLT
populate-pdf-form-fields-using-xslt.description: Shows how to load an XML file, apply an XSLT stylesheet, and use the transformed data to fill fields in an Aspose.Pdf form.

create-pdf-with-acroform-calculation.title: Create PDF Order Form with AcroForm Fields and JavaScript Calculation
create-pdf-with-acroform-calculation.description: Demonstrates how to build a PDF containing AcroForm text fields for line items and a button that runs embedded JavaScript to calculate item totals and a grand total.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-csv.title: Export PDF Form Fields to CSV
export-pdf-form-fields-to-csv.description: Loads a PDF document, iterates through all form fields, extracts each field's name, type, and value, and writes the information to a CSV file for external analysis.

add-hidden-session-id-field-to-pdf.title: Add Hidden Session Identifier Field to PDF
add-hidden-session-id-field-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to insert a hidden text box form field into a PDF to store a session identifier for backend tracking.

set-default-appearance-for-pdf-text-fiel.title: Set Default Appearance for a PDF Form Text Field
set-default-appearance-for-pdf-text-fiel.description: Demonstrates how to define the default font, size, and color (DA) for a text box form field in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

bulk-fill-pdf-form-fields-from-json.title: Bulk Fill PDF Form with Graceful Missing Field Handling
bulk-fill-pdf-form-fields-from-json.description: Demonstrates how to populate multiple fields in a PDF form using Aspose.Pdf while skipping fields that are absent or of the wrong type, and logging any errors without aborting the operation.

add-fallback-metadata-to-pdf.title: Generate PDF from XML with Fallback Values
add-fallback-metadata-to-pdf.description: Shows how to read data from an XML file, supply default values when nodes are missing, and create a simple PDF using Aspose.Pdf text fragments.

set-dashed-border-for-pdf-form-field.title: Set Dashed Border for PDF Form Field
set-dashed-border-for-pdf-form-field.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locate a specific form field widget, and apply a dashed border style (with color) to visually differentiate optional input areas.

set-beveled-border-on-pdf-form-field.title: Set Beveled Border Style for PDF Form Field
set-beveled-border-on-pdf-form-field.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate a TextBox form field, and apply a beveled (3‑D) border style using Aspose.Pdf before saving the document.

apply-background-image-to-pdf-form-field.title: Apply Background Image to PDF Form Button Field
apply-background-image-to-pdf-form-field.description: Shows how to place an image behind a button form field in a PDF by locating the field's page, creating an ImageStamp sized to the field rectangle, and adding the stamp to the page using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-form-data-to-indented-json.title: Export PDF Form Data to Indented JSON
export-pdf-form-data-to-indented-json.description: Loads a PDF document, extracts values from all form fields, and writes the data to a formatted JSON file for easy consumption.

import-form-data-from-json-via-rest-api.title: Import Form Data from JSON via REST API into PDF
import-form-data-from-json-via-rest-api.description: Demonstrates how to fetch JSON data from a REST endpoint, map the values to matching PDF form fields, and save the populated document using Aspose.Pdf.

center-align-text-field-in-pdf-form.title: Center Align Text Box Field in PDF Form
center-align-text-field-in-pdf-form.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate a text box form field, set its horizontal alignment to center, define its default appearance, and save the updated document.

create-right-aligned-numeric-text-field.title: Set Text Field Alignment to Right in PDF Form
create-right-aligned-numeric-text-field.description: Loads a PDF, accesses a TextBoxField in the form, sets a numeric value and notes the right‑alignment limitation in the current Aspose.Pdf version.

add-date-picker-field-to-pdf.title: Add Date Picker to PDF Form Field using JavaScript
add-date-picker-field-to-pdf.description: Shows how to create a text box form field in a PDF and attach a JavaScript action that opens the built‑in date picker when the field receives focus, using Aspose.Pdf.

populate-currency-value-in-pdf-form.title: Populate PDF Form Field with Formatted Currency
populate-currency-value-in-pdf-form.description: Demonstrates formatting a decimal as a currency string and assigning it to a TextBox form field in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-email-form-field.title: Validate Email Before Saving PDF
validate-email-form-field.description: Shows how to check that an email address contains an '@' character before saving a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and stores the email in the document's metadata.

remove-form-field-from-pdf.title: Remove a Form Field from a PDF
remove-form-field-from-pdf.description: Shows how to verify a form field's presence and delete it from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's form API.

insert-form-field-at-specific-index.title: Insert Form Field at Specific Index in PDF
insert-form-field-at-specific-index.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a TextBoxField, inserting it into the Form.Fields collection at a given zero‑based index to control layout order, and saving the modified document.

create-pdf-acroform-open-js.title: Create PDF with AcroForm fields and document-level JavaScript
create-pdf-acroform-open-js.description: Demonstrates generating a PDF, adding AcroForm text box and checkbox fields, and assigning a document‑level JavaScript action that runs when the PDF is opened.

export-pdf-form-data-to-json-gzip.title: Export PDF Form Data to JSON and GZip Compress
export-pdf-form-data-to-json-gzip.description: Demonstrates extracting form field values from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, serializing them to JSON, and compressing the result with GZip for efficient storage or transmission.

import-encrypted-xfdf-form-data.title: Import Encrypted XML Form Data into PDF
import-encrypted-xfdf-form-data.description: Demonstrates decrypting an AES‑CBC encrypted XML file and populating an Aspose.Pdf form with the extracted field values.

set-rich-text-field-html.title: Set Rich Text Content of a PDF Form Field Using HTML
set-rich-text-field-html.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, locating a TextBox form field, enabling rich‑text mode via reflection, and assigning HTML‑formatted content using Aspose.Pdf's RichTextFragment.

create-pdf-with-acroform-tooltips.title: Create PDF with AcroForm Fields and Tooltips
create-pdf-with-acroform-tooltips.description: Shows how to generate a PDF, add text box and checkbox AcroForm fields, and assign tooltips using the Contents property of the field widgets.

import-form-data-from-json.title: Import Form Data from JSON into a PDF
import-form-data-from-json.description: Shows how to read a JSON array of field name/value objects, locate matching form fields in a PDF, set their values, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-form-data-to-xml-custom-root.title: Export PDF Form Data to XML with Custom Root Element
export-pdf-form-data-to-xml-custom-root.description: Demonstrates how to read form fields from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, create an XML document with a custom root element, and save the result to a file.

add-calculated-total-field-with-javascri.title: Add Calculated Total Field with JavaScript to PDF Form
add-calculated-total-field-with-javascri.description: Shows how to insert a read‑only text box into a PDF form and attach JavaScript that sums all numeric text fields to display a running total.

add-current-time-datefield-to-pdf.title: Set Form Field Default Time on PDF Load
add-current-time-datefield-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locate a TextBox form field, assign the current system time formatted as HH:mm:ss, and save the document so the value appears when the PDF is opened.

add-dynamic-barcode-field-to-pdf.title: Populate Barcode Field with Dynamic Value in PDF
add-dynamic-barcode-field-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF template, locating a BarcodeField by name, assigning a unique runtime value, and saving the updated document.

validate-required-pdf-form-fields-before.title: Validate Required PDF Form Fields Before Exporting to FDF
validate-required-pdf-form-fields-before.description: The example loads a PDF form, checks that all fields marked as required contain a value, and only then exports the data to an FDF file.

verify-pdf-form-field-count.title: Verify PDF Form Field Count and Fill Text Boxes
verify-pdf-form-field-count.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf to check the number of form fields in a PDF, abort processing if the count is unexpected, and populate text box fields with a default value.

bind-pdf-with-formeditor-save-modified-p.title: Modify PDF Form Fields with FormEditor
bind-pdf-with-formeditor-save-modified-p.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, binding it to Aspose.Pdf.Facades.FormEditor, optionally updating form field values, and saving the modified document.

set-max-length-for-pdf-text-field.title: Set Character Limit on PDF Form Field
set-max-length-for-pdf-text-field.description: Demonstrates how to limit the number of characters a user can enter in a PDF form field using Aspose.Pdf's FormEditor. The example loads a PDF, applies a 50‑character limit to the "CustomerName" field, and saves the result.

add-checkbox-field-to-pdf-form.title: Add Checkbox Field to Existing PDF
add-checkbox-field-to-pdf-form.description: Shows how to insert a new checkbox form field named 'AgreeTerms' into an existing PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

delete-form-field-from-pdf__v2.title: Delete a Form Field from a PDF
delete-form-field-from-pdf__v2.description: Shows how to remove a specific form field from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf by invoking Document.Form.Delete and then saving the updated document.

remove-typewriter-form-fields-page-3.title: Remove Typewriter Form Fields on Page 3
remove-typewriter-form-fields-page-3.description: Loads a PDF, applies a TextFragmentAbsorber to page 3, finds all TextBox (Typewriter) form fields on that page, deletes them from the form collection, and saves the updated document.

export-acroform-data-to-xml.title: Export AcroForm Data to XML
export-acroform-data-to-xml.description: Shows how to read all AcroForm fields from a PDF document and write each field's name and value into an XML file.

import-acroform-data-from-xml.title: Import AcroForm Data from XML into PDF
import-acroform-data-from-xml.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with an AcroForm, reading field values from an XML file, mapping them to matching form fields, and saving the updated PDF.

add-submit-button-to-pdf.title: Add Submit Button with URL Action to PDF
add-submit-button-to-pdf.description: Shows how to programmatically create a button field in a PDF form and assign a SubmitFormAction that posts the form data to a specified URL using Aspose.Pdf.

limit-textboxfield-input-length.title: Validate TextBox Field Character Limit in PDF
limit-textboxfield-input-length.description: Demonstrates creating a PDF with a text box form field, manually enforcing a 50‑character limit, and verifying that a 60‑character input is truncated correctly.

batch-set-comments-maxlen.title: Batch Set 100‑Character Limit on PDF Comments Field
batch-set-comments-maxlen.description: Processes all PDFs in a folder, truncates any existing value in the "Comments" form field to 100 characters, and adds client‑side JavaScript to enforce the same limit for future entries.

list-form-field-names-types-char-limits.title: List PDF Form Fields with Types and Character Limits
list-form-field-names-types-char-limits.description: Opens one or more PDF files, enumerates all AcroForm fields, and prints each field's name, type, and character limit (when applicable).

update-pdf-form-fields.title: Update PDF Form Fields with Aspose.Pdf
update-pdf-form-fields.description: Loads a PDF document, sets values for a text box, a checkbox, and a radio‑button group using Aspose.Pdf Forms API, and saves the modified file.

export-acroform-data-to-xfdf.title: Export AcroForm Data to XML on a Network Share
export-acroform-data-to-xfdf.description: Loads a PDF, extracts its AcroForm fields, builds an XML representation, and saves the XML file to a UNC network share.

import-xml-form-data-into-multiple-pdfs.title: Synchronize Form Data Across Multiple PDFs from XML
import-xml-form-data-into-multiple-pdfs.description: Shows how to load form field values from an XML file and apply them to several PDF documents, keeping the form data synchronized across the PDFs.

remove-form-fields-first-page.title: Remove Form Fields from First PDF Page
remove-form-fields-first-page.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locating widget annotations on the first page, deleting the associated form fields, and saving the cleaned page as a template.

add-paymentmethod-radio-button-group.title: Create PaymentMethod Radio Button Group in PDF Form
add-paymentmethod-radio-button-group.description: Demonstrates how to add a radio button group named 'PaymentMethod' with 'Credit' and 'Debit' options to a PDF form using Aspose.Pdf, set a default selection, and save the document.

set-default-selected-radio-button-value.title: Set Default Radio Button Selection in PDF
set-default-selected-radio-button-value.description: Demonstrates how to programmatically set the default selected value of a radio button group in a PDF form using Aspose.Pdf.

add-multiline-feedback-text-field.title: Add Multiline Feedback TextBox to PDF Form
add-multiline-feedback-text-field.description: Shows how to insert a multiline text box field named 'Feedback' into an existing PDF document using Aspose.Pdf and save the updated file.

remove-signature-form-fields.title: Remove Signature Form Fields from PDF
remove-signature-form-fields.description: Shows how to iterate through a PDF's form collection, identify fields of type SignatureField, and delete them using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-csv__v2.title: Export PDF Form Fields to CSV
export-pdf-form-fields-to-csv__v2.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, read its AcroForm fields, retrieve each field's current value, and write the name/value pairs to a UTF‑8 CSV file.

populate-pdf-form-from-csv.title: Import CSV Data into PDF Form Fields
populate-pdf-form-from-csv.description: Shows how to read a CSV file, map its header values to matching PDF form field names, and populate those fields using Aspose.Pdf before saving the result.

create-hidden-audit-timestamp-field.title: Add Hidden Creation Timestamp Field to PDF
create-hidden-audit-timestamp-field.description: Shows how to insert a hidden text box form field that stores the document creation timestamp (ISO‑8601) for audit purposes using Aspose.Pdf.

set-pdf-form-field-read-only__v2.title: Make PDF Form Field Read‑Only
set-pdf-form-field-read-only__v2.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF, set a TextBox form field value, and mark the field as read‑only using Aspose.Pdf so users cannot modify it after generation.

copy-form-fields-to-another-pdf.title: Copy Form Fields from One PDF to Another
copy-form-fields-to-another-pdf.description: Shows how to load a source and destination PDF, iterate over the source AcroForm fields, clone each field, add it to the destination document on the correct page, and save the updated PDF.

create-pdf-country-dropdown.title: Create Country Dropdown List in PDF
create-pdf-country-dropdown.description: Shows how to add a ComboBox (dropdown) form field to a PDF and fill it with a predefined array of country names using Aspose.Pdf.

set-default-selected-country-in-pdf-comb.title: Set Default Country in PDF ComboBox
set-default-selected-country-in-pdf-comb.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, locate a ComboBox form field, ensure a specific option exists, and set it as the default selected value using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-age-numberfield-non-numeric-inp.title: Validate Numeric TextBoxField Rejects Non-Numeric Input
validate-age-numberfield-non-numeric-inp.description: Creates a PDF with an 'Age' TextBoxField, then attempts to set alphabetic characters and manually checks that non‑numeric input is rejected, demonstrating numeric validation for form fields.

add-calculation-button-to-pdf-form.title: Add JavaScript Calculation Button to PDF Form
add-calculation-button-to-pdf-form.description: Shows how to create a PDF form with Quantity, Unit Price, and Total fields and a button that runs JavaScript to calculate the total price.

remove-javascript-actions-from-pdf-form-.title: Remove JavaScript Actions from PDF Form Fields
remove-javascript-actions-from-pdf-form-.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through all form fields and clears any attached JavaScript actions, then saves the secured document.

batch-convert-pdfs-to-xml.title: Batch Convert PDFs to XML Form Data
batch-convert-pdfs-to-xml.description: Shows how to iterate through a directory of PDF files, load each with Aspose.Pdf, and save them as XML form data while preserving the original file names.

synchronize-pdf-form-data-using-xfdf.title: Synchronize PDF Form Data via XML Export/Import
synchronize-pdf-form-data-using-xfdf.description: Exports form field values from a source PDF to an XML file and imports them into a target PDF, updating the target with the same data.

set-tooltip-for-pdf-email-field.title: Set Tooltip for Email Form Field in PDF
set-tooltip-for-pdf-email-field.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locate a TextBoxField named "Email", assign a tooltip (using the Contents property) to guide the required email format, and save the modified document.

highlight-mandatory-text-field-border-re.title: Highlight Mandatory Text Field with Red Border
highlight-mandatory-text-field-border-re.description: Shows how to set a solid red border on a PDF text box field using Aspose.Pdf to flag mandatory information.

add-signature-field-with-image-stamp.title: Add Signature Field with Image Stamp to PDF
add-signature-field-with-image-stamp.description: Shows how to create a signature form field named 'ClientSignature' in a PDF and overlay it with a predefined image stamp using Aspose.Pdf.

sign-pdf-and-lock-signature-field.title: Lock Signature Field After Signing in PDF
sign-pdf-and-lock-signature-field.description: Shows how to sign a PDF signature field with a certificate using Aspose.Pdf and then lock the field to prevent further modifications.

create-hidden-calculation-field.title: Create Hidden Calculation Field with JavaScript in PDF
create-hidden-calculation-field.description: Demonstrates how to add two input text fields and a hidden total field to a PDF form, then use JavaScript to calculate and store the sum of the inputs.

export-selected-form-fields-to-xml.title: Export Selected PDF Form Fields to XML
export-selected-form-fields-to-xml.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, select specific form fields by name, and write their values into a simple XML document.

import-xml-update-pdf-form-fields.title: Update PDF Form Fields from XML Data
import-xml-update-pdf-form-fields.description: Shows how to load an XML file containing field values and update matching form fields in a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-date-field-validation.title: Validate Date Format Using Regular Expression
create-pdf-date-field-validation.description: Shows how to use a compiled regular expression to verify that a string matches the MM/DD/YYYY date format in C#.

set-password-field-max-length.title: Set Maximum Length for PDF Password Field
set-password-field-max-length.description: Demonstrates how to enforce a 20‑character limit on a PDF password text box using a JavaScript action and how to enable password masking via reflection.

create-pdf-form-template-fill-from-json.title: Create and Fill PDF Form from JSON
create-pdf-form-template-fill-from-json.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF form template with placeholder fields, then populate those fields using data deserialized from a JSON file.

batch-fill-pdf-forms-from-csv.title: Batch Fill PDF Forms from CSV Data
batch-fill-pdf-forms-from-csv.description: Demonstrates how to load PDF form templates, populate their fields with values from a CSV file, and save a separate filled PDF for each data row.

import-xfa-form-data-with-missing-xml-ha.title: Import XML Data into PDF Form with Missing File Handling
import-xfa-form-data-with-missing-xml-ha.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, importing form field values from an XML file, handling the case where the XML file is missing, and saving the updated document with proper error handling.

set-form-field-visibility-based-on-anoth.title: Toggle Form Field Visibility Based on Checkbox Value
set-form-field-visibility-based-on-anoth.description: Loads a PDF, reads a checkbox field, and shows or hides another form field by setting the Hidden annotation flag, then saves the result.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v3.title: Export PDF Form Fields to JSON Schema
export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v3.description: Loads a PDF, extracts its form fields, and writes a JSON schema describing each field's name, type, value, and required flag. Useful for integrating PDF forms with external form builders.

generate-pdf-form-fields-from-json.title: Generate AcroForm Fields from JSON Schema
generate-pdf-form-fields-from-json.description: Shows how to load a JSON schema, parse its properties, and dynamically create matching AcroForm fields in a new PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

set-checkbox-default-checked.title: Set Checkbox Default State to Checked in PDF
set-checkbox-default-checked.description: Shows how to create a PDF, add a checkbox form field, and set its default state to checked programmatically using Aspose.Pdf.

add-submit-button-http-post-pdf-form.title: Configure PDF Submit Button for HTTP POST
add-submit-button-http-post-pdf-form.description: Shows how to add a button field to a PDF and set a SubmitFormAction that posts the form data in URL‑encoded format to a specified URL.

add-reset-button-to-pdf-form__v2.title: Add Reset Button to PDF Form
add-reset-button-to-pdf-form__v2.description: Shows how to create a button field in a PDF that clears all form fields by attaching a JavaScript reset action.

set-export-value-radio-button-option.title: Set Export Value of Radio Button Option in PDF
set-export-value-radio-button-option.description: Loads a PDF, locates a radio button field, changes the export (Name) value of a specific option, and saves the modified document.

create-pdf-with-hidden-guid-tracking-fie.title: Create PDF with Hidden GUID Tracking Field
create-pdf-with-hidden-guid-tracking-fie.description: Shows how to generate a GUID at runtime, add it as a hidden text box form field in a PDF, and save the document using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-transform-import-pdf-form-data.title: Transfer PDF Form Data Between Documents
extract-transform-import-pdf-form-data.description: Demonstrates extracting form fields from a source PDF, transforming the data, and creating new form fields in a target PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

set-initial-zoom-level-for-pdf-form.title: Set Initial Zoom Level for PDF Viewer
set-initial-zoom-level-for-pdf-form.description: Shows how to load a PDF form with Aspose.Pdf, set the viewer's initial zoom percentage via ViewerPreferences, and save the updated document.

lock-all-pdf-form-fields.title: Lock All Form Fields in a PDF
lock-all-pdf-form-fields.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, set every form field to read‑only, and save the document, effectively locking the form from further edits.

create-pdf-form-with-barcode-field__v2.title: Create PDF Form with Barcode Placeholder Field
create-pdf-form-with-barcode-field__v2.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF form using Aspose.Pdf, add a button field to act as a barcode placeholder, and include a text box pre‑populated with a numeric identifier.

set-file-attachment-size-limit.title: Set Maximum File Size for PDF File Attachment Field
set-file-attachment-size-limit.description: Shows how to limit a PDF file attachment form field to 2 MB using Aspose.Pdf by setting the MaxFileSize property.

export-pdf-form-field-metadata-to-csv.title: Export PDF Form Field Metadata to CSV
export-pdf-form-field-metadata-to-csv.description: Shows how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, read its form fields, extract each field's name, type and default value, and write the data to a CSV file for auditing.

import-form-fields-from-csv.title: Import PDF Form Fields from CSV
import-form-fields-from-csv.description: Shows how to read a CSV file containing field metadata and dynamically create corresponding AcroForm fields (text boxes, checkboxes) in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-date-picker-field-current-date.title: Add Date Picker Field Defaulting to Current Date
add-date-picker-field-current-date.description: Demonstrates how to add a text box field that acts as a date picker to an existing PDF and set its default value to the current system date when the document is opened.

add-date-field-validation.title: Validate Date Picker Minimum Date in PDF Form
add-date-field-validation.description: Demonstrates adding JavaScript validation to a PDF date picker field to reject dates earlier than January 1, 2000 and setting a compliant default value.

create-pdf-form-with-dynamic-list-box.title: Create PDF Form with Dynamic Combo Box List
create-pdf-form-with-dynamic-list-box.description: Shows how to generate a PDF document containing a combo box form field that can serve as a dynamic list, adding initial options and applying basic styling.

duplicate-pdf-form-field.title: Duplicate and Rename PDF Form Fields
duplicate-pdf-form-field.description: Demonstrates how to programmatically duplicate an existing PDF form field, assign new names, and add multiple copies to the document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-javascript-email-validation-to-pdf-f.title: Add JavaScript Email Validation to PDF Form Field
add-javascript-email-validation-to-pdf-f.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate the 'Email' TextBoxField, attach a JavaScript action that checks for an '@' character, and save the updated document.

create-pdf-form-tax-calculation.title: Create PDF Form with Tax Calculation
create-pdf-form-tax-calculation.description: Shows how to build a PDF form containing subtotal and percentage fields and automatically compute the tax amount using JavaScript attached to the OnCalculate event.

export-pdf-form-data-to-xml__v3.title: Export PDF Form Data to XML for Offline Collection
export-pdf-form-data-to-xml__v3.description: Shows how to load a PDF, optionally set form field values, and export all form field data to a local XML file using Aspose.Pdf.

import-tax-rate-xml-pdf-hidden-field.title: Load Tax Rates from XML into Hidden Field as JSON
import-tax-rate-xml-pdf-hidden-field.description: Shows how to read tax rate entries from an XML file, convert them to a dictionary, serialize to JSON, and store the result in a hidden field for client‑side calculations.

set-noexport-flag-for-sensitive-pdf-form.title: Set NoExport Flag for Sensitive PDF Form Fields
set-noexport-flag-for-sensitive-pdf-form.description: Shows how to open a PDF, iterate through its form fields, detect sensitive ones, and apply the NoExport flag so they are omitted from exported data.

validate-required-pdf-form-field.title: Highlight Required TextBox Field with Red Border on Validation
validate-required-pdf-form-field.description: Demonstrates how to create a required text box in a PDF form using Aspose.Pdf, detect an empty value after submission, and apply a red border to indicate the validation error.

auto-update-qr-code-from-text-field.title: Auto‑Update QR Code from Text Field in PDF Form
auto-update-qr-code-from-text-field.description: Shows how to attach JavaScript to a barcode field so that a QR code updates automatically when the linked text box value changes, using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-form-data-to-xml-and-transfor.title: Export PDF Form Data to XML and Transform with XSLT
export-pdf-form-data-to-xml-and-transfor.description: Shows how to extract form field values from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, save them as an XML file, and then apply an XSLT stylesheet to generate a custom report such as HTML.

repopulate-pdf-form-fields-from-xml.title: Import XML Data into PDF Form Fields
repopulate-pdf-form-fields-from-xml.description: Shows how to load a PDF, read a simple XML file containing form field values, map those values to matching PDF form fields, and save the populated document using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-multi-select-list-box.title: Create PDF Form with Multi-Select List Box
create-pdf-multi-select-list-box.description: Shows how to generate a PDF document containing a form with a multi‑select list box, add options, pre‑select items, and save the file using Aspose.Pdf.

add-multi-select-list-box-max-3.title: Set Maximum Selections for a Multi‑Select List Box
add-multi-select-list-box-max-3.description: Demonstrates how to enable multi‑selection on a PDF list box, limit the number of selectable items to three, and apply a JavaScript fallback when the MaxSelection property is unavailable.

add-hidden-ip-field-to-pdf.title: Add Hidden IP Address Field to PDF Form
add-hidden-ip-field-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a hidden text box field in a PDF, inject JavaScript that captures the client IP address on document open, and store it in the field using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-ipv4-address-in-pdf-form-field.title: Validate IPv4 Address Using Regular Expression
validate-ipv4-address-in-pdf-form-field.description: Demonstrates how to validate an IPv4 address string with a regular expression in C#.

create-pdf-form-digital-signature.title: Create PDF Form with Signature Field
create-pdf-form-digital-signature.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF document, add instructional text, and insert a required digital signature field using Aspose.Pdf.

require-signature-field-lock-pdf.title: Add Required Signature Field and Lock PDF After Signing
require-signature-field-lock-pdf.description: Shows how to create a required digital signature field, apply a PKCS#7 signature, and lock the PDF for further changes using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-digital-signature-to-xml.title: Export PDF Signature Details to XML
export-pdf-digital-signature-to-xml.description: Loads a signed PDF, iterates over its signature form fields, extracts signer information and signature properties, and writes them to an XML file for audit logging.

import-signature-from-xml.title: Import XML Signature Data and Sign PDF Field
import-signature-from-xml.description: Loads signature parameters from an XML file, locates the appropriate signature field in a PDF, creates a PKCS7 signature using a certificate, and applies the signature to the field.

create-pdf-form-with-password-protection.title: Create PDF Form with Password‑Protected Editable Field
create-pdf-form-with-password-protection.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF, add a textbox form field, and apply user/owner password encryption that permits only form filling after authentication.

add-password-textbox-field-to-pdf.title: Secure PDF Form Field by Making It Read‑Only
add-password-textbox-field-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to protect a PDF form field by setting it to read‑only using Aspose.Pdf core API as a workaround for password‑style protection.

validate-incorrect-password-prevents-acc.title: Validate Incorrect Password Prevents Access to Encrypted PDF
validate-incorrect-password-prevents-acc.description: The example creates a PDF, encrypts it with user and owner passwords, then shows that opening the file with a wrong password throws an InvalidPasswordException, while using the correct password allows text extraction.

create-pdf-form-with-automatic-backup.title: Create PDF Form with Automatic Backup on Field Change
create-pdf-form-with-automatic-backup.description: Shows how to build a PDF form with a text box that executes JavaScript to save a backup copy each time the field loses focus after a modification.

add-javascript-listener-to-pdf-form-fiel.title: Add JavaScript Listener for PDF Form Field Change
add-javascript-listener-to-pdf-form-fiel.description: Shows how to attach a JavaScript function to a PDF form field that triggers when the field's value changes, using Aspose.Pdf.

import-form-appearances-from-json.title: Apply JSON Appearance Settings to PDF Form Fields
import-form-appearances-from-json.description: The example reads a JSON file with font, color, and border settings for form fields, finds matching fields in a PDF, and applies those appearance properties using Aspose.Pdf.

create-collapsible-section-pdf-form.title: Create Collapsible PDF Form Section with Checkbox
create-collapsible-section-pdf-form.description: Demonstrates how to build a PDF form where a checkbox toggles the visibility of a hidden text box using Aspose.Pdf, JavaScript actions, and annotation flags.

collapse-pdf-outline-section.title: Set Initial Collapsed State for PDF Form Section
collapse-pdf-outline-section.description: Loads a PDF, locates a button field that controls a collapsible section, sets its value to "Off" so the section starts collapsed, and saves the updated document.

add-calculated-total-price-field-to-pdf-.title: Add Calculated Total Price Field to PDF Form
add-calculated-total-price-field-to-pdf-.description: Shows how to insert Quantity and Unit Price text boxes into a PDF, add a read‑only Total Price field, and use JavaScript to calculate the total based on the other fields.

export-total-price-to-xml.title: Export Calculated Total Price to XML
export-total-price-to-xml.description: Demonstrates extracting monetary values from a PDF with TextAbsorber, summing them, storing the total as custom metadata, and saving the document as XML for integration with an external invoicing system.

generate-pdf-discount-from-xml.title: Import Discount Rates from XML and Apply to Order Total
generate-pdf-discount-from-xml.description: Shows how to load discount codes from an XML file into a dictionary and use the selected rate to calculate a discounted total for a list of order items.

pdf-form-pdf-only-attachment-field.title: Create PDF Form with PDF File Attachment
pdf-form-pdf-only-attachment-field.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF document, add a file attachment annotation limited to PDF files, and save the result as a form using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-file-attachment-size-in-pdf-for.title: Validate PDF File Size Before Processing
validate-file-attachment-size-in-pdf-for.description: Demonstrates how to check that a PDF file does not exceed a 5 MB limit before loading it with Aspose.Pdf and performing further operations.

export-pdf-conversion-progress-to-xml.title: Export Progress Value to XML
export-pdf-conversion-progress-to-xml.description: Shows how to obtain a progress value (e.g., from command‑line arguments) and persist it to an XML file with a timestamp using XDocument and FileStream.

add-javascript-localization-to-pdf-form.title: Add Locale‑Based Dynamic Label to PDF
add-javascript-localization-to-pdf-form.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF with a combo box for selecting a locale and a read‑only label that updates via a JavaScript dictionary when the locale changes.

create-pdf-form-with-required-field-vali.title: Enable Submit Button After Required Fields Are Filled
create-pdf-form-with-required-field-vali.description: Shows how to generate an HTML file containing JavaScript that disables the submit button until every required input, textarea, or select has a non‑empty value.

create-pdf-form-with-analytics.title: Create PDF Form with Interaction Logging via JavaScript
create-pdf-form-with-analytics.description: Demonstrates how to add a hidden log field to a PDF form and attach JavaScript actions to visible fields to record each interaction (focus, blur, keystroke).

add-submit-button-export-interaction-log.title: Export PDF Form Interaction Log to XML
add-submit-button-export-interaction-log.description: Loads a filled PDF, reads its AcroForm fields, and writes each field's name and value to an XML file for server‑side analysis.

import-xfdf-interaction-log-into-pdf.title: Reconstruct User Interactions in PDF from XML Log
import-xfdf-interaction-log-into-pdf.description: Loads an XML interaction log and adds corresponding text annotations to the specified pages of a PDF, then saves the reconstructed document.

add-auto-updating-datetime-field-to-pdf.title: Add Dynamic Date/Time Field to PDF
add-auto-updating-datetime-field-to-pdf.description: Shows how to create a text box form field in a PDF and automatically fill it with the current date and time using document‑level JavaScript.

add-read-only-date-field-to-pdf.title: Set PDF Date Field to Read‑Only
add-read-only-date-field-to-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, fills a text box form field with the current date‑time and marks the field as read‑only to prevent further user edits.

conditional-pdf-section-checkbox.title: Create Conditional PDF Form Section with Checkbox
conditional-pdf-section-checkbox.description: Shows how to add a checkbox to a PDF form and toggle the visibility of another field using JavaScript based on the checkbox state.

export-pdf-model-to-xml.title: Export Conditional Visibility Settings to XML
export-pdf-model-to-xml.description: Loads a tagged PDF, iterates through its structure elements, and writes each element's visibility state to an XML file to preserve user preferences across sessions.

apply-xml-visibility-to-pdf-annotations.title: Import Visibility States from XML and Apply to Tagged PDF Sections
apply-xml-visibility-to-pdf-annotations.description: Loads visibility settings from an XML file and applies them to the corresponding tagged sections of a PDF, setting the hidden flag for sections marked as hidden.

create-pdf-form-with-concatenated-barcod.title: Create PDF Form with Barcode Placeholder
create-pdf-form-with-concatenated-barcod.description: Shows how to add text fields to a PDF form, concatenate their values, and store the result in a read‑only field that can act as a barcode placeholder.

export-barcode-fields-to-xml.title: Export Barcode Field Values to XML
export-barcode-fields-to-xml.description: Shows how to read barcode form fields from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and write each field's name and value into an XML document for integration with inventory systems.

export-pdf-form-data-to-json__v6.title: Export PDF Form Data to JSON
export-pdf-form-data-to-json__v6.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, read all form fields, serialize the name/value pairs to a formatted JSON string, and write the result to a file.

export-pdf-form-data-to-xml__v6.title: Export PDF Form Data to XML
export-pdf-form-data-to-xml__v6.description: Demonstrates exporting form fields from a PDF to JSON, converting the JSON to a simple XML representation, and writing the XML (or streaming it) for immediate download.

create-rtl-textbox-form-field.title: Create RTL TextBox Form Field in PDF
create-rtl-textbox-form-field.description: Shows how to add a right‑to‑left (RTL) text box field to a PDF form with Aspose.Pdf, including setting default appearance, border, and saving the document.

get-character-limit-of-pdf-form-text-fie.title: Get Character Limit of a PDF Form Text Field
get-character-limit-of-pdf-form-text-fie.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate a text box form field named 'Address', and read its maximum character length using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-form-fields-from-page.title: Remove Form Fields from a Specific PDF Page
remove-form-fields-from-page.description: Shows how to iterate through a PDF's form collection and delete all fields that belong to a given page (page 5) using Aspose.Pdf.

create-submit-button-pdf.title: Create Submit Button in PDF to Post Data
create-submit-button-pdf.description: Shows how to add a button field to a PDF document and configure it to submit form data to a specified URL using Aspose.Pdf.

flatten-pdf-form-fields__v2.title: Flatten PDF Form Fields to Static Content
flatten-pdf-form-fields__v2.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, flatten all interactive form fields so they become static content, and save the resulting PDF.

create-and-flatten-pdf-form-field.title: Create and Flatten a PDF Form Field
create-and-flatten-pdf-form-field.description: Shows how to create a PDF document, add an AcroForm text box field, and flatten the form so the field becomes static PDF content using Aspose.Pdf.

simulate-form-post-verify-200-ok.title: Simulate Form POST and Verify 200 OK
simulate-form-post-verify-200-ok.description: Shows how to send URL‑encoded form data using HttpClient and validate that the server returns a 200 OK response.

add-tooltip-to-pdf-submit-button.title: Add Tooltip to PDF Submit Button
add-tooltip-to-pdf-submit-button.description: Shows how to locate a button field in a PDF form and assign a tooltip (alternate caption) using Aspose.Pdf.

set-text-field-background-color-light-gr.title: Set Text Field Background Color to Light Gray
set-text-field-background-color-light-gr.description: Shows how to locate a TextBoxField in a PDF form with Aspose.Pdf, set its background-like color to light gray, and save the updated document.

export-pdf-form-data-to-xml__v4.title: Export Calculated Tax from PDF Form to XML
export-pdf-form-data-to-xml__v4.description: Loads a PDF form, reads the Amount field, calculates tax, writes the result back to a Tax field, and exports the calculation as an XML file for downstream processing.

pdf-form-language-switch.title: Create PDF Form with Language‑Switching Labels
pdf-form-language-switch.description: Shows how to build a PDF form containing a language selection combo box that dynamically updates read‑only label fields via JavaScript.

batch-apply-custom-font-to-pdf-form-text.title: Batch Apply Custom Font to PDF Form Text Fields
batch-apply-custom-font-to-pdf-form-text.description: Shows how to load a TrueType font and set it as the default appearance for all text box fields in multiple PDFs stored in a network folder.

batch-fill-pdf-form-from-datatable.title: Batch Fill PDF Form from DataTable using Aspose.Pdf
batch-fill-pdf-form-from-datatable.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF form template, iterate over a DataTable of records, populate matching text fields, flatten the form, and save each filled PDF to a directory.
